summary.text: Vernon Criss is a member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 12 who lost the Republican primary on May 12, 2026, and is running as an Independent write-in candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an executive by profession.

paragraphs.text: Vernon Criss graduated from Parkersburg High School and earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia Wesleyan College.
His career experience includes working as an executive.
